pages.text: When idle, only one CPU will be displayed, but EC will generate CPUs on demand based on the number of tasks. $(br)All bytes and parallel count will also be shared and allocated on demand.

pages.text1: Thread cores provide threads, and the number of threads determines the maximum number of CPUs that can exist.。
pages.text2: Each hyper-threading core provides twice the number of threads as a normal core, but each thread will consume 10% extra bytes.
